proposed_comments.title: Remove the unused work-area query
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove the unused work-area query

**Severity:** `low`

The PR removes `workAreaPhysical` from `UpdateTasklistButtons`, but the surrounding method still assigns `Rect workArea = DisplayHelper.GetWorkAreaForDisplayWithWindow(hwnd);` and keeps the now-unused `Windows.Foundation` import. Remove both so the cleanup does not leave dead display-work-area code behind. This is a warning-risk/code-quality issue; it does not change runtime behavior.

confidence.rationale: The pinned upstream diff removes the workAreaPhysical argument but leaves the local Rect assignment and its only-purpose import unused; exact upstream and candidate builds both pass here, so the evidence supports a dead-code/warning-risk cleanup rather than a reproduced functional failure.
